tone.evidence: The respectful obituary tone survives, since the text is unchanged; the broken swaps add unintended oddness.

tone.evidence: Respectful and warm throughout; nothing flippant: "announced that he had died surrounded by loved ones".

B.summary: A natural, accurate light-Aussie obituary at exactly the asked weight.

meaning.evidence: Every fact survives, in order. "was into politics, getting behind a few causes" slightly undersells "active in politics, advocating for several causes".

sense.evidence: Terms mostly fit: "muso", "had a crack at a solo career", "a whole heap of other groups". "a regular at Grateful Dead gigs" for a song strains a little; "was into politics" is looser than "active".

authenticity.evidence: Natural Australian: "picked up the guitar at 13", "kept playing live till just months before he died". Keeps US date order ("October 16, 1947").

register.evidence: Level 3, light and conversational; perhaps a touch more casual than B for an obituary ("was into politics") but on brief.

tone.evidence: Respectful throughout, though "was into politics" is a little offhand for an obituary.

variety.evidence: Varied: "muso", "gigs", "had a crack at", "a whole heap of", "getting behind".
